text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was refreshing. 
Gentildonna-san, I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, that was quick.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The bathwater was a little hot today. And 
also..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to have Ms. Gentile look over 
and critique my race theory report.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've written most of it... but I want to 
aim for something even better.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heh. Very well. Which one?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Regarding the 
cornering section...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —You bought a new tail brush, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Amazing, you can tell just like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You have chosen something quite fine 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Watching Gentil-san made me want 
to reach a little higher too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was so surprised when I switched. 
To think a single brush could make such a 
difference.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Here, you should use this oil as 
well. It makes a world of difference in 
keeping it smooth and tidy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Thank you so much for 
sharing such a precious private story!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now, a question for the two of you! As 
roommates who spend so much time together, 
how do you feel about one another?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I am so glad to be paired with this 
person. For me, that sums it all up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
How she tackles her challenges, how she 
spends her days... How she approaches her 
races...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Every single one was wonderful and so 
sophisticated. Thanks to you, Gentile-san, 
polishing myself has become so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...! What do you think, 
Gentile-san?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Had it been an ordinary opponent, they 
certainly would have been 'worn down' to 
nothing by me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Or perhaps she's terrified of being 'worn 
down' and is running away from the very 
start..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—without flinching, without 
yielding, take it as your fuel. To that 
spirit, I offer my gratitude and respect.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am truly delighted to have such a 
formidable roommate.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentile... Hehe. Same here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I-I-I-I...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"A mutual trust born from both being 
strong...! And woven together through 
casual everyday moments...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Behind every strong person stands 
another! Trainer, you two are wonderful 
together!"
choice_data_list:
I hope you two will continue pushing each 
other with everything you've got.

We can look forward to even further 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If Gentildonna keeps polishing you, 
you might turn into a gorgeous jewel one 
day!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Why not become one? —A beautiful gem 
that no one has ever laid eyes on before.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of further evolution... Our room 
underwent an evolution of its own 
recently!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Turn it into an unconscious workout room!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I've replaced all my everyday 
accessories with custom-made, 
ultra-heavyweight versions.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
For example, just pulling out a desk chair 
can train your arms. Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"My. Others wouldn't be able to handle it 
so easily, though. Ho ho ho."
